integrity: The proof is coefficientwise from Corollary 3.9: refined tropical multiplicities are Laurent polynomials, every non-polynomial factor is an inverse quantum integer, and partition constraints bound its exponent. The finite checker only confirms the elementary partition-exponent maximization in bounded examples; the universal statement is deductive.
scientific_limitations: The denominator is a universal clearing denominator and need not be reduced. Root-of-unity pole orders are upper bounds; cancellations can lower or remove them. No asymptotic statement for genus coefficients is asserted.
title: A universal quantum-integer denominator for fixed-degree descendant series
